set system host-name DeviceB.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols bfd all-interfaces.explanation: Enables BFD protocols on all interfaces.

parameters.name: bfd-configuration
parameters.explanation: The configuration options for BFD protocols, such as 'all-interfaces', indicate that BFD is enabled on all interfaces.

set protocols ospf 1.explanation: This command configures OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) protocol settings in Junos, where `[parameter1]` specifies the specific OSPF parameter to be defined or modified.

area 0.0.0.0.explanation: Configure examples and areas of the OSPF protocol.

bfd local-discriminator 2.explanation: Configures the BFD local identifier for the interface.

parameters.name: local-discriminator
parameters.explanation: BFD local identifier for the only BFD session.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet6 address 2001:DB8:2::1/64.explanation: Configure the IPv6 address of the interface and the length of the subnet prefix.

parameters.name: ipv6-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv6 address assigned to the interface.

set chassis standby version 2.explanation: Configure the version of the backup kit.

parameters.name: version
parameters.explanation: The version number of the backup box.

set chassis standalone-group 1.explanation: The command `set chassis standalone-group [parameter1]` configures a standalone chassis group in Junos, where `[parameter1]` specifies the group identifier for redundancy or management purposes.

failover-address inet6 2001:DB8:2::100.explanation: Configure a failed IPv6 address for an independent group.

parameters.name: failover-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv6 address of the malfunction.
